g.text: RP2040 controller core and its GPIO isolation in one block: the full rp2040 core - W25Q128JVPIQ QSPI flash, 12 MHz ABM8 crystal, decoupling, BOOTSEL and RUN switches - plus four SN74CB3Q3245RGYR 8-channel bidirectional FET bus switches, with all 29 MCU-to-switch connections made inside the block so that routing is placed once instead of re-drawn per board.

g.text: Supply: always-on +3.3V for IOVDD, USB_VDD, ADC_AVDD, VREG_IN, the flash and the switches' VCC (2.3-3.6 V); the regulator makes +1.1V for DVDD. Each switch draws 1 mA typ, 2 mA max on or off (about 4 mA typ, 8 mA max total). Isolation rests on the enable, not on Ioff.

g.desc: Supply: always-on +3.3V for IOVDD, USB_VDD, ADC_AVDD, VREG_IN, the flash and the switches' VCC (2.3-3.6 V); the regulator makes +1.1V for DVDD. Each switch draws 1 mA typ, 2 mA max on or off (about 4 mA typ, 8 mA max total). Isolation rests on the enable, not on Ioff.

g.text: The ISO side is a bare pass gate: no level shift, buffer or protection. Switch I/O is rated to 5.5 V but the MCU pad behind it is limited to IOVDD + 0.3 V; pulls on the switched side reference the switched rail, never +3.3V. Unused ports get no-connect flags on the placing sheet.
